verdict.rationale: OpenClaw describes itself as a gateway to "AI coding agents". Its `exec` tool runs mutating shell commands that create and edit files in the workspace, and releases mention "repository-backed cloud work". Community reports say it used Claude Code as its harness via `claude -p`, but Anthropic has since restricted that use to API access only, which limits the embedding path. missing for 10: first-party docs on supervising or embedding external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), explicit clone/test workflow documentation, hands-on corroboration of end-to-end repo work.
